opportunities.concept: Juliana enters the forbidden West Wing and finds the Dowager Duchess gravely ill, ending on the poisoning cliffhanger
opportunities.why_promising: The hook 'Do not stare. Keep walking.' opens within the first 3 seconds of a 35-second clip (96000-131000ms). The clip moves from the manor corridor to the bedchamber, where Juliana says 'This isn't ordinary fever' (E75) and the Duchess convulses. It ends unresolved on the poisoning cliffhanger (E80).

opportunities.concept: Juliana passes the Housekeeper's test and learns the way to the West Wing
opportunities.why_promising: The Housekeeper's menacing threat 'keep your eyes and ears where they belong' opens a 22-second clip (66000-88000ms) within the first 3 seconds. It runs through the tense hiring test and ends on Prudence's warning that few servants go to the West Wing, which leaves the destination unresolved.
